desc: STANDARD adult male build: exactly the slender long-legged Elf body proportions from the reference.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: reusable modular pixel-art BODY LAYER for a fantasy sprite rig.
The attached sheet is a POSE AND BODY-PROPORTION GUIDE ONLY. The existing heads are saved separately and WILL NOT be changed by this task.
Create the neck-down body sprites ONLY, like detachable costume mannequin body layers. Omit the ENTIRE head, face, ears, hair, horns, tail and accessories; leave that whole space truly transparent. The body ends in a clean smooth little rounded NECK ATTACHMENT NUB at the shoulders, no wound or gore. No placeholder head or circle.
STANDARD adult male build: exactly the slender long-legged Elf body proportions from the reference.
Keep ALL TWELVE reference poses in exactly THREE rows of FOUR views. Columns in EVERY row are SOUTH front, NORTH back, EAST/right-facing, WEST/left-facing. Row1 neutral idle with arms down; row2 walking step A, row3 walking step B with the opposite arms and legs swinging. Keep the arm and leg positions of the reference, especially distinct forward/back swing in profiles. Keep the same proportions and same relative cell positions/common foot baseline within each row. Generous transparent gutters between every figure.
Replace exposed skin color with a neutral cool LIGHT GRAY four-tone mannequin palette, so the same body layer can later be tinted to every race. Body shading light gray 125-240 luminance, dark one-logical-pixel outline, clothing dark charcoal 25-65 luminance. Keep skin and clothing clearly separable. No armor, gloves, boots, weapons, jewelry, straps or belt. Bare feet and bare hands. Male bodies wear only charcoal shorts; female bodies wear charcoal shorts and a simple charcoal bandeau/crop top.
Style: match the reference's true chunky 64x64 RPG sprite pixel clusters at integer nearest-neighbor enlargement. Clean deliberate edges and small flat tone clusters, restrained anatomy, no high-resolution realistic rendering, no fuzzy gradients, no random colored edge pixels, no decorative details.
Transparent alpha background, no ground or shadow, no grid, captions, labels or text. Exactly twelve NECK-DOWN modular BODY sprites; zero heads.
